decisions.reason: The concept has already shown a quantified customer saving and remains visible in 2024, so its value is increasingly proven and the cost of keeping it open appears low.

It has stayed on its own page across two years and fits the firm's core recycling portfolio, but the lack of visible reference results and overlap with newer shredder launches leave a moderate rationalization risk.
As a flagship modular concept with a named customer adoption and strong quantified savings, it looks strategically important and already validated in the market.
As a 2024 launch, it is still an option under evaluation, and in a growing innovative firm it is sensible to keep it while more market evidence emerges.
It complements the firm's modular and mobile processing systems and is still too new for uncertainty to be fully resolved, so keeping the option open is the better choice.
